sections.Epic Created: EPIC-QUERY: Complex Query Expression System. Implements generalized query expression parser compiling to Query builder. Function registry pattern for extensibility. Success criteria: 90% coverage, no hardcoded entities, performance within 2x of direct Query builder.
sections.Implementation Notes:
1. Use DI container for testing: create_container(got_dir=tmp_path)
2. T-001-A CRITICAL: EntityType enum only covers 5 of 12 types - use string-based dispatch with SchemaRegistry
3. No hardcoded magic numbers - depth/length limits are opt-in, not default
4. Query language is READ-ONLY by design
5. Filter eval/exec patterns BEFORE any parsing (security requirement)
